description: This Java source file defines the class DestinationCommandConsumer, a specialized consumer for handling AMQP command messages targeted at devices or gateways within the Eclipse Hono framework. It manages device-specific command handlers, processes incoming command messages by dispatching them to the correct handler, and handles the lifecycle of the underlying AMQP receiver link.

classes.name: DestinationCommandConsumer
classes.description: A specialized AMQP command message consumer that manages device-specific handlers, processes incoming messages, and maintains the connection lifecycle within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: addDeviceSpecificCommandHandler
methods.description: Adds a device-specific command handler, associating it with a device (and optional gateway), ensuring no handler duplication.

methods.name: addDeviceSpecificCommandHandler
methods.description: Adds a CommandHandlerWrapper object as a command handler, validating IDs and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: handlerIsForConsumerGatewayOrDevice
methods.description: Checks if the handler's device and gateway IDs match those of this consumer.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Returns true if the underlying receiver link is open and not marked as closed.

methods.name: handleCommandMessage
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, dispatching it to the appropriate command handler based on device ID, including tracing support.

methods.name: containsCommandHandler
methods.description: Checks whether there is a command handler registered for a specific device ID.

methods.name: getCommandHandlerOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a command handler for a specified device ID or defaults to the consumer's device ID.

methods.name: getCommandHandlers
methods.description: Returns a collection of all command handlers managed by this consumer.

methods.name: onRemoteClose
methods.description: Handles remote link closure, invoking the provided handler and notifying all command handlers.

methods.name: removeHandlerAndCloseConsumerIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes the handler for a specified device ID and closes the consumer if no handlers remain.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DestinationCommandConsumer instance by establishing an AMQP receiver link with specified handlers for local and remote closure events.
